summary: Backend-only smoke test of ObraControl API. All 13 requested checks passed including CRUD, filters, stats, budget, CSV export, category defaulting, receipt image upload with Gemini OCR extraction, and file download.
passed: GET /api/ -> 200 with categories list (6 Spanish categories)
POST /api/expenses -> 200, creates expense with UUID id, returns full model
POST /api/expenses with unknown category 'NoExiste' -> defaults to 'Otros'
GET /api/expenses -> 200 lists all expenses sorted by date desc
PUT /api/budget -> 200 sets total=50000, GET /api/budget returns it
GET /api/stats -> 200 returns total_spent, count, budget, remaining, progress, by_category (6 items in fixed order), monthly list
GET /api/expenses/export -> 200 text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment, UTF-8 BOM, ; delimited, Spanish headers

POST /api/receipts/scan (real receipt JPEG) -> 200, uploaded to Emergent Object Storage, Gemini 3.1 Pro extracted vendor=LEROY MERLIN, date=2026-02-10, amount=101.04 (float), category=Materiales (valid), 5 items with description+price, notes
